notes.title: Ver1.24 BUGFIX
notes.notes: 修正WIN11系統下點擊角色整備按鈕時的錯誤。

notes.title: Ver1.16 UPDATE
notes.notes:
Ver1.16 amendment list
1. Fixed the bug that the enhanced store is invalid.
2. Fixed the error in the final words of the Hilde line.
3. Added the difficulty hint for the Hild line (C line).
4. When the island's intelligence is full, it cannot continue to invest in intelligence points.
5. Added some text prompts.
6. Added support for achievements.

notes.title: Update Ver1.14
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the problem that the wrong opening of the Hilde route caused the world map to be wrong.
2. Fixed some other problems and deleted old achievement codes that may cause errors.

notes.title: UPDATE Ver 1.13
notes.notes:
Ver1.13 amendment list
1. Fixed the related events of Hild.
2. Fixed the error in the final chapter of the C line.
3. Fix the problem of early activation of the C line Leeds event.

notes.title: UPDATE V1.12
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the bug that the vertical drawing was not displayed before the battle.
2. Improved the ability of the B route to finally talk to one's own reinforcements. Under difficult difficulty, Medes should not be too afraid of the enemy of the abyss.
3. Update the engine to the latest version.

notes.title: UPDATE Ver 1.10
notes.notes:
1. Alice's dawn state will end normally after the level.
2. Chapter 6 adds the result of defeat after 21 rounds.
3. Fixed some errors in vertical drawing.
4. Route C is added, 4 official levels are added, which can be entered in the dialogue in Chapter 8. (You can also enter directly through the mysterious box code, please check the original author CIEN for the specific code)
5. The maid costume of the main character is newly added, which can be selected in the stronghold event after the passage of Chapter 7.
6. Players who missed the mystery box can now obtain a new mystery box through the stronghold event after Chapter 7 is completed.
7. Fixed the problem of Alice's persuasion of the captives.

notes.title: VER1.03 UPDATE
notes.notes:
Ver1.03 revision list
1. Fixed some magic display effects.
2. Restore the difficulty of Chapter 5.
3. Correct the difficulty and some BGM errors in Chapter 7.
4. Correct some errors.
5. Turn off the defense function that was opened by mistake. (Zina finally relieved the burden...)
6. Fixed part of the wrong vertical drawing.
7. Now you can change the difficulty of the game in the environment options of the base.

notes.title: UPDATE
notes.notes:
Ver1.02 revised content list
1. Salia’s support to Tiana is closed, and now Tiana has nothing to do with Salia for the time being.
2. Restored the opening of the treasure chests in Chapters 6 and 7, now something will pop out of it.
3. The difficult task guidance in Chapter 5 has been restored. [Raksha Yezakura] is no longer a hidden reward.
4. Corrected some errors in the chronology.
5. The description and attributes of the multi-week reward [Holy King’s Helm] have been revised.
6. The captive who was persuaded by Alice is now the same as being persuaded by Kilbard at level 26.
7. The function of combat prediction pointing is restored.

notes.title: Update announcement
notes.notes:
Fix
1. The point of battle prediction is temporarily deleted and will be fixed in the next version.
2. Corrected some text errors.
3. Fixed some errors in the favorability of Nono in the first stage.
4. Deleted items that should not appear in the base.
